medium.en: Folding fan mounted as an album leaf; ink and colour on gold-flecked paper
medium.zh: 折扇面，装为册页，洒金笺设色

basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1559. The Metropolitan Museum of Art releases this image under CC0 through its Open Access programme.
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1559 年。大都会艺术博物馆通过开放获取计划以 CC0 发布此图像。

alt.en: A folding fan painting on gold-flecked paper. A wide lake opens across the arc of the fan, with small islands and tufts of trees floating on it, and a column of inscription with seals stands at the right.
alt.zh: 一幅洒金笺上的折扇面。宽阔的湖面沿着扇形展开，湖上浮着几座小岛和一丛丛树木，右侧是一行题字和几方印章。

note.en: Painted by Wen Zhengming in the same year as his Living Aloft on this wall, on a fan meant to be carried and opened in the hand. Lake Tai, near his home city of Suzhou, was the great lake of the region and a favourite of its painters. The curved format bends the horizon, so the lake seems to open around you.
note.zh: 文徵明在画《楼居图》的同一年画了这把扇面，扇子本是要随身携带、在手中展开的。太湖就在他家乡苏州附近，是这一带的大湖，也是当地画家钟爱的题材。扇形把地平线弯了起来，湖面仿佛在你四周展开。
